claims.claim: The FCC accepted SpaceX's bid for Grain's 800 MHz spectrum covering 546 paired licenses across 3,224 counties reaching roughly 100% of the U.S. population.
claims.episode_span: The FCC accepted SpaceX's bid for Grain's 800 MHz spectrum, opening review for Starlink Mobile. The deal covers 546 paired licenses across 3,224 counties, reaching roughly 100% of the U.S. population in all 50 states, Washington, D.C., Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands.
claims.source_title: SpaceX just cleared a key FCC hurdle in its fight with Verizon and AT&T
claims.supporting_quote: The Federal Communications Commission has formally opened its review of SpaceXs plan to buy a nationwide block of 800 MHz spectrum from Grain Management, moving Starlink Mobile one step closer to operating as a full U.S. wireless carrier.
